source: Pinned public CUB BlockHistogramAtomic and BlockHistogram initialization; DeviceHistogramEven unit-width integer bins
adaptation: Sequential C instantiation of BlockHistogram initialization and atomic Composite, replacing atomicAdd with integer +=1; runtime extents replace Bins and ITEMS_PER_THREAD. Map direct integer bins to DeviceHistogramEven with lower=0, upper=bins, levels=bins+1. Valid input indices and count<=INT_MAX ensure no overflow and order-independent exact counts.

specs.name: cub_histogram_even_i32
assumptions: All input indices are in [0,bins); disjoint int32 input/output
count<=INT_MAX ensures all int32 counts are representable; bins+1 is int32-representable
